title: Selected Topics in Aerospace Engineering; An Introduction to Large Eddy Simulations
description:
Prerequisite: Permission of instructor.

This course will provide students with an introduction to the theory of large-eddy simulations (LES) for incompressible flows. The errors which arise when trying to numerically solve the Navier Stokes equations will be discussed with emphasis on the relevance of the resolution error for LES. A key focus will be on various filtering operations, especially from the point-of-view of LES and their application to the solution of the Navier-Stokes equations. At the end of the course the student will have knowledge about the methods, approaches, and subgrid models used for LES.
